scraped.scraped_description: New_ Public’s app for local communities enters closed beta in five pilot communities

name: New_ Public Roundabout
tagline: A community space for neighbors — local digital forum app built from the ground up with community stewards
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: early-stage product (closed beta as of Nov 2025)
limited to five pilot communities at launch
dependent on New_ Public nonprofit sustainability

news_articles.headline: Introducing Roundabout: built for neighbors, with neighbors

outcome_methodology: National survey on local digital spaces conducted with Center for Media Engagement, University of Texas at Austin
documented_limitations: closed beta, not publicly available as of Nov 2025
failure_modes: enshittification risk if revenue model shifts
curation_criteria: Topic-based channels; local stewards set community norms; no algorithmic virality by design
contributor_governance: Steward-led; each community has its own steward(s); New_ Public sets platform values
community_ownership: Intended to grow toward community control; currently nonprofit-incubated
political_relevance_summary: New_ Public Roundabout operates in the local democracy, community building, digital public infrastructure space, contributing tools or resources that support civic engagement, transparency, or democratic processes.

movement_building_utility.notes: New_ Public Roundabout enables civic participation and amplifies community voices in democratic processes.

generalizability_notes: Limited generalizability. New_ Public Roundabout is proprietary and context-specific. While the model could inspire similar initiatives, direct replication would require building from scratch.
